bio.text: Lily Williams, a Republican, is a candidate for New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia says Williams was born in Chengdu, China, earned a bachelor's degree from Fudan University in 1985 and a graduate degree from the University of Texas at Austin in 1991.
The candidate's career experience includes real estate investing, work as a buyer's agent, business ownership, legal consulting, and medical social work.
